svg.title: CG2 Glaze Search - full information flow
svg.text: CG2 Glaze Search · System Architecture (Information Flow)
3 flows · 14 processing stages · Flow 3 = card G, recipe search with the smart-search upgrade (RUN_GLAZE_SEARCH.bat)
Runs once per data update: recipe photos → reviewed, described ceramic objects
On demand: answers a user's photo, words or formula
On demand: free text, photo, formula or a colour → Glazy recipes, about 0.1 s
Grounding DINO base · SAM 2.1 Hiera-Large · OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 (LAION-2B) · DINOv2 ViT-L/14 · MiniLM-L6-v2 (sentence-transformers)

attributes v3 · object-search heads (TF-IDF, DINOv2, UMF + ingredients) · colour match: text + chemistry heads, PCA-16, K-Means-12 · smart search: text / photo / formula heads → 256-d (InfoNCE), K-Means-10, tag model
Glaze photos → reviewed, described ceramic objects → the right recipe, found by look, shape and colour, or by your words, a photo, a formula or a colour
